verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-retention windows and no deletion or redaction endpoint for customer PII. The nearest items are adjacent features that earn no credit for this story: a 5-second TTL on export download URLs, the ability to unmonitor customers, and case audit trails. Retention and erasure controls are a fair question for a KYC/AML screening platform that holds identity data, so the axis applies, and the absence of evidence makes this none rather than na.
